name: Sleepy Sentry
notes: DRAFT for C13-1 (bestiary-plan.md). A drowsy stone statue. It yawns, then stomps a long purple stripe. Stats are TODO for the Researcher (ENEMY_SCALE). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
senseiLine: Purple stripes? DASH out of them.
description: A drowsy stone statue. It yawns, then stomps a long purple stripe.

bestiary.tip: DASH out of the stripes. They can't be COUNTERed.

lore.white: This old guard fell asleep on duty when the shadow came. Wake it gently, and it stands watch again.
